summary: No EVENT or PROBLEM today. Lula's surprise win in the Brazil runoff hit the real and Brazilian equities: ARCO -12% (BofA downgrade to Neutral, target $12 to $9, confirmed) and MELI -9%. ARCO is in buy range and this is currency and political fear rather than a broken business, but its debt and owner-earnings flags keep it at WATCH. DECK (-6%) and KNSL (-5%) keep yesterday's open checks. ACGL and CINF reported without a break. The tech and semiconductor sell-off is price noise far above MOS.

items.why: Cause confirmed: real weakness and fiscal worries; ~40% of revenue is Brazil. Fear, not a moat break, but debt >3x FCF and owner earnings <75% flags leave event check 5 unproven. Price $8.09 vs MOS $9.64.

items.why: Macro/political price move, not business news (METHOD 7). Price $1,810 vs MOS $551: far from buy range.
